anterior_cranial_contour.melon_arc_radius: Broad, smooth convex arc originating from the blowhole region and terminating at the rostral crease.
anterior_cranial_contour.rostrum_aspect_vector: Short, robust beak with a pixel thickness approximately half of its visible horizontal length from the inflection point.
anterior_cranial_contour.cranial_inflection_angle: Obtuse interior angle visible at the pixel coordinate where the melon's downward slope meets the dorsal plane of the rostrum.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Multiple faint, linear depigmented striations (rake marks) are visible on the mid-lateral flank and the base of the pectoral fin.
other_distinctive_markers: Dark elliptical eye positioned posterior to the rostrum; large, paddle-shaped pectoral fin visible on the ventral-lateral aspect.
